test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Machinist) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options correctly describes the significance of the first letter in the ISO-designated tool insert code 'C NMG 12 04 08-MP'?

options.text: It denotes the shape of the insert used in machining.
It indicates the cutting-edge geometry of the insert.
It specifies the material of the insert used for machining.
It designates the type of coating applied to the insert for wear resistance.

solution:
**Concept**

 
• Indexable tool inserts are identified using a standardized coding system established by **ISO 1832**.
 
• The code consists of a sequence of letters and numbers that define the geometry, dimensions, and mounting features of the insert.
 
• The very first letter in the sequence identifies the **shape** of the insert.

**
**ISO Insert Nomenclature Breakdown**

For the given code C NMG 12 04 08-MP**, the positions represent the following:

 
• **1st Letter (C):** Insert Shape (Rhombic 80^circ)
 
• **2nd Letter (N):** Clearance/Relief Angle (0^circ)
